content: The job of the function NvM_ReadBlock shall set the request result to NVM_REQ_INTEGRITY_FAILED if: - the MemIf reports MEMIF_BLOCK_ INCONSISTENT and - NvMRomBlockDataAddress is not configured (no ROM block with default data is available) for the block and - NvMInitBlockCallback is not configured (no init callback) for the block.
